description: This shell script defines functions and configurations for handling 'xfrm' protocol setup and teardown in a networking context on a Linux-based system. It includes functions for initializing configurations, setting up the protocol, and tearing it down, with direct manipulation of JSON data and protocol-specific parameters.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_setup
methods.description: Sets up the xfrm protocol configuration based on input parameters and JSON data, including tunnel configuration, zone, multicast, and other parameters.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder function for tearing down the xfrm protocol; currently does nothing.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes default configuration parameters for xfrm, such as mtu, tunlink, zone, ifid, and multicast.
